description: This Java class implements a transaction factory that utilizes Geronimo's transaction manager within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to obtain transaction management objects, database connections, and handles class initialization and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: GeronimoTransactionFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing transaction management and database connection provisioning using Geronimo's transaction framework within the OFBiz ecosystem.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns the Geronimo TransactionManager instance used for managing transactions.

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Returns the UserTransaction object, essentially the Geronimo TransactionManager.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this transaction manager implementation.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a database connection based on the helper info and associated datasource configuration.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup by closing all connection factories managed by this factory.
